lead_de: Hinter der Pupille liegt alles, was wir für Unternehmen machen. Scroll weiter – du fliegst mitten hindurch.
lead_en: Behind the pupil lies everything we make for businesses. Keep scrolling – you fly right through it.
lead_tr: Gözbebeğinin arkasında işletmeler için yaptığımız her şey var. Kaydırmaya devam et – tam içinden geçiyorsun.

stations.text_de: Kurze Clips für Instagram und TikTok, die im Feed hängen bleiben – Idee, Dreh und Schnitt aus einer Hand.
stations.text_en: Short clips for Instagram and TikTok that stop the scroll – idea, shoot and edit from one team.
stations.text_tr: Akışta durduran Instagram ve TikTok klipleri – fikir, çekim ve kurgu tek elden.

stations.text_de: Spots für Social Media, Anzeigen und Bildschirme – vom Konzept bis zum fertigen Schnitt.
stations.text_en: Spots for social media, ads and screens – from concept to final cut.
stations.text_tr: Sosyal medya, reklam ve ekranlar için spotlar – konseptten son kurguya.

stations.text_de: Bilder, die Lust machen – für Karte, Website, Anzeigen und Social Media.
stations.text_en: Images that make people want it – for menus, websites, ads and social media.
stations.text_tr: İştah açan görseller – menü, web sitesi, reklam ve sosyal medya için.

stations.text_de: Logos und Erscheinungsbilder mit einer eigenen, wiedererkennbaren Bildsprache.
stations.text_en: Logos and identities with their own recognisable visual language.
stations.text_tr: Kendine has, akılda kalan bir görsel dile sahip logolar ve kimlikler.

stations.text_de: Websites, Social-Media-Auftritte und Anzeigen – als ein zusammenhängendes System gedacht.
stations.text_en: Websites, social media presence and ads – designed as one connected system.
stations.text_tr: Web siteleri, sosyal medya ve reklamlar – tek bir bütün olarak düşünülmüş.

stations.text_de: Wir machen auch Filme, die niemand bestellt hat – wie den UFO-Kurzfilm, mit dem diese Seite beginnt.
stations.text_en: We also make films nobody ordered – like the UFO short film this page opens with.
stations.text_tr: Kimsenin sipariş etmediği filmler de yapıyoruz – bu sayfanın başladığı UFO kısa filmi gibi.
